issue.title: Apply the series gate after the solve in modecount_common.setup

labels.name: mac
labels.description: Task for mac, the coordinator's M5 Mac

issue.body:
**What.** In `hp/modecount_common.setup`, apply the series gate (`series_tail` ≤ 1e-15) after the solve as well as before it, with a check that fails without it. Recommended in #254's summary (its task 1).

**Why.** The gate runs on the resampled start, which can pass while the solution fails. D 45 kf 21's start passes at 7.4e-74, while its solution has 2.4e-8 (#254). A fresh setup would therefore accept that background today.

**Acceptance (can fail).** Setup refuses the D 45 kf 21 solution (from I170-macm3) and accepts the 22 states #141 checked. A mutation that removes the post-solve gate accepts D 45 kf 21.

**Depends on.** #254.

comments.body: started (mac, M5 10 cores, shared and loaded). Worktree `.claude/worktrees/agent-aa720666cf3a50dbc` on main 1f805b5, branch backed up to wip/i265. At most 1 compute process at a time, nice 10 (coordinator, lighter load). #270 follows on the same branch.

## Closing summary (mac, 23:08 UTC)

**setup now applies the series gate to the solution as well as to the start, and it refuses the D 45, M 48, kf 21 background.** The start of that solve passes at 7.4e-74, and its solution fails at 2.4e-8. A planted check and a real end-to-end solve both show the refusal, and the mutation that removes the new gate accepts the state.

**Code** (wip/i265, **27a258c**; files `hp/modecount_common.py`, `hp/modecount_probe.py`; no rebuild):
- `series_gate(s, zh, zl, meta, when)` is the gate that #141 wrote inline. `setup` calls it on the start, as before, and again on the solution after the |F| check.
- `prepare(...)` is setup's load, resample and fit step, split out so the check can build the start without a solve.
- `DATA` is the directory where setup keeps re-converged states (still hp/data). `modecount_probe.py --setup --data=DIR` redirects it.

**Checks** (each 1 process, nice 10; logs in raw):

| run | exit | result |
|---|---|---|
| `modecount_probe.py --gatecheck --raw=RAW` | 0 | 2/2 |
| `--gatecheck --mutate=nogate_after` | **1** | check 1 fails, because setup accepts the D 45 kf 21 solution (\|F\| 8.2e-17) |
| `--gatecheck --mutate=tight` (gate 1e-16) | **1** | check 2 fails, because both D 30 M 48 no-cut states are refused (4.8e-16) |
| `modecount_probe.py --selftest` (#141) | 0 | 5/5, unchanged |
| end to end: `modecount_probe.py hp/data/states/up7_D45.0507.npz --M=48 --kf=21 --setup --fmax=1e-15 --data=<raw>/I265-mac/states` | 1 (refused) | see below |

- Check 1 runs setup from `up7_D45.0507.npz`, resampled to M 48 with kf 21. Its start passes (centre 7.4e-74, horizon 1.3e-27). The solve is planted, so Newton returns #170's solution (I170-macm3), and the check confirms that state has the start's layout (M 48, nodes 0.3 … 0.7, kt 36, kc 420, ks 100). setup refuses it with "series not converged in this layout (solution; …): centre 2.4e-08 (ratio 0.967 at 0.3)".
- Check 2 applies the gate after the solve to #141's 22 states, each on its stored layout with the cut setup gives it (`_kfN` in the name, otherwise 13 from D 35 on). All 22 pass, and the worst is 4.8e-16 (D 30, M 48 without the cut). Every tail matches I141-mac/probe/gate_states.log. setup itself was not run on them: one of the 22, D 61 M 48 kf 13, has |F| 2.7e-15 and was never counted, so setup's |F| gate would refuse it.
- End to end, Newton left |F| at 3.2e-9, Levenberg-Marquardt brought it to 8.2e-17, and setup refused the solution (centre 2.4e-8). That took 1570 s. The state reproduces #170's: the same layout, |F| 8.1688e-17 against 8.1688e-17, Δ within 2.1e-18, and the largest component difference 1.7e-12.

**Raw.** choptuik-large-d-raw `I265-mac/` at **8e1174fd**: README.md, the logs (each with its command, code commit, exit and wall time), gatecheck.json, setup_D45_kf21.json and the refused state (`states/`).

**Discrepancies.** None. One behaviour to know about: setup saves a re-converged state before its |F| and series gates, as it already did for |F|. A rerun then loads that state and refuses it at the start gate without solving.

**Proposed text for notes/MODE_COUNT.md §5** (the D 45 paragraph). Replace "#141's series gate runs before the solve, so a fresh setup would accept that background (#265)." with:

> `modecount_common.setup` now applies the series gate to the solution as well, and refuses that background (#265; raw `I265-mac/`). `hp/modecount_probe.py --gatecheck` checks this, and its mutation `nogate_after` fails.

**Recommended tasks.** None new. #264 (the D 45 kf 21 zero on a background that passes both gates) is the follow-up that this gate now enforces.

cpu: load 5.9 (1 min) on 10 cores; my one process ran at nice 10. Memory: 73% free system-wide, swap 5.6 of 7.2 GB used, my process about 0.2 GB.

Coordinator: reviewed and merged (wip/i265 at bfe5fd5). Here `--gatecheck` passes 2/2 and `nogate_after` gives 1/2 and exit 1. `--tolcheck` passes 2/2 and `nocentretol` gives 1/2 and exit 1. `--selftest` passes 5/5. #264 can now run on a gated background.
